service.name: Private party entertainment in Boulder
service.serviceType: Live music for dinner parties and private celebrations
service.description: Live music for Boulder private parties, solo to trio, with caps and curfews honoured as written and every rate published.

faqs.q: How late can a band play in Boulder?
faqs.a: As late as your venue's own rules allow; we honour caps and curfews as written. Boulder venues and neighborhoods set earlier ceilings than Denver's, so we put the loud chapter early and finish at dinner volume. Give us the cap and the cut-off at contract and the last set is shaped to land inside both.

faqs.q: Does travel from Denver add to a Boulder quote?
faqs.a: One flat line, the published Front Range travel rate, printed on the rate card next to every performance figure. It covers the whole trip; there is no mileage arithmetic and no lodging line for Boulder, and the performance rate itself is the same one a Denver host sees.

faqs.q: What size fits the Community House at Chautauqua or a Boulderado event floor?
faqs.a: Solo to trio. These are conversation-first venues with neighbours and guests close by, and three pieces is the most sound the evening usually wants. A solo or duo holds dinner at 65 to 72 dBA; a trio adds the lift for toasts and a small floor without crowding the ceiling.

faqs.q: Can music play outside at a Boulder home?
faqs.a: Yes, early and at dinner volume. We play outdoors on a covered, level and dry area with power run to it, and Colorado evenings cool fast, so instruments come indoors as the night does. An early patio set at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table keeps the evening on good terms with the street.
